components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Royal fill CTA — Approve, Inbox, New property.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #2D1659; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 14px; font: 500 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2D1659; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined decline / secondary action beside primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.15); border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24104D; padding: 8px 14px; font: 500 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.03); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2D1659; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status NEW
components.description: Sole gold use — NEW urgency chip.
components.css: .ds-status-new { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 600 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: rgba(200, 155, 44, 0.15); color: #24104D; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(200, 155, 44, 0.35); }

components.name: Status In Review
components.css: .ds-status-review { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 600 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #F3F0FA; color: #2D1659; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.2); }

components.name: Ops Input
components.description: White field with hairline border and royal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24104D; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.15); }

components.name: Ops Panel
components.description: Square white work surface with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.04); font: 400 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #24104D; } .ds-panel-head { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); padding: 12px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-panel-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.08); } .ds-panel-row:first-of-type { border-top: none; } .ds-panel-row:hover { background: rgba(243, 240, 250, 0.3); }

components.name: Rail Nav Active
components.html: EnquiriesBookings
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 200px; padding: 12px 8px; background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); font: 400 13px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item { display: block; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.04); color: #24104D; } .ds-rail-item-active { background: #2D1659; color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.25); } .ds-rail-item-active:hover { background: #2D1659; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Status Tab
components.description: Underline status tab with count badge.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); font: 400 13px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: -1px; color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.55); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #24104D; } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: #2D1659; color: #2D1659; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab-count { border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.05); color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.45); } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-count { background: rgba(45, 22, 89, 0.1); color: #2D1659; }

components.name: Queue Row
components.description: Dense enquiry queue row with selection hairline.
components.css: .ds-queue-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px 12px; width: 100%; border: none; border-left: 2px solid transparent; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: 400 13px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #24104D; } .ds-queue-row:hover { background: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.025); } .ds-queue-row-active { border-left-color: #2D1659; background: rgba(243, 240, 250, 0.5); } .ds-queue-meta { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-queue-meta strong { font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-queue-meta small { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.5); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-queue-total { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-status-new { display: inline-flex; align-self: start; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font: 600 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: rgba(200, 155, 44, 0.15); color: #24104D; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(200, 155, 44, 0.35); }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Hairline-divided count strip — not SaaS cards.
components.html: Open enquiries4Bookings12Published stays8Confirmed revenueGHS 48k
components.css: .ds-metric-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); background: #FFFFFF; font: 400 13px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric { display: block; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.1); text-decoration: none; color: #24104D; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-metric:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-metric:hover { background: rgba(243, 240, 250, 0.4); } .ds-metric span { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(36, 16, 77, 0.45); } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview:
This is the internal Request-to-Book ops console for MOJO Apartments — a working tool, not a marketing shell. The metaphor is a concierge desk pad: a slim ops rail, a dense enquiry queue, and a request folio open beside it so approve/decline never loses the list. Surfaces stay paper-flat; brand shows up as royal actions and restrained lavender selection, not as guest-site costume.

Density is the point. Rows, hairline rules, and tabular totals replace airy cards and SaaS metric tiles. System UI sans is intentional on admin so scanning stays fast; the public site may keep Inter and promotional patterns separately.
keyCharacteristics: Paper stone ground with cream sheet chrome and white work surfaces
Royal for primary actions and active chrome; gold reserved for NEW urgency
Hairline brand-ink rules and dense 13px rows — no marketing cards
Split queue + folio on Enquiries; tables elsewhere
Soft 6–8px corners on controls; square panels and sheets

rules.name: The Gold Urgency Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on NEW status chips. Every other accent is royal or lavender.

rules.name: The No Metric-Card Rule
rules.body: Counts live in hairline-divided strips or tab badges — never in elevated SaaS stat cards with shadows or icon tiles.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: Admin uses the system UI stack. Do not import Inter, serif display, or marketing display faces into /admin.

rules.name: The Queue-Beside-Folio Rule
rules.body: Triage never replaces the list with a full-page detail. Selection paints a royal left hairline + lavender wash; the folio updates in place.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer borders and paper layers over shadow. No multi-layer drop shadows, glows, or floating cards.

dos: Do keep Enquiries as queue + folio side by side so triage never loses the list.
Do use royal for primary actions and active chrome; lavender for selection/hover wash.
Do reserve gold exclusively for NEW status chips.
Do set admin type to the system UI stack and keep body copy at ~13px dense.
Do separate surfaces with brand-ink/10 hairlines on paper stone / sheet cream / white.
donts: Don't build SaaS metric-card dashboards (icon tiles, soft shadows, rounded marketing cards) inside /admin.
Don't reuse public-site Inter/marketing hero patterns, full-bleed imagery, or gold icon decoration in the ops shell.
Don't use gold on buttons, nav, or decorative iconography.
Don't introduce rounded-full pills or multi-layer glow shadows on ops controls.
Don't open enquiry detail as a full-page takeover that hides the queue.
